objective: Make /scaffold generate a new project for any stack at the stack-agnostic floor. One copy script writes the CI gates, the dependency audit, the general handbooks, the topology anchor and the scaffold AgDR into workspace/<name>/. A spec that no golden path fits gets the custom start.
why: o1 is achieved at 27de5bd. The spec and the rules table exist, but /scaffold writes no project files yet. Every stack gets the floor, so the floor comes before the typescript-nextjs starter (owner choice, 2026-10-13). This slice meets ac2-5, ac2-6 and ac2-16 only in part. The starter slice completes them.
